faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.subtitle: Find quick answers to common questions about Thulo Bazaar
faq.cantFindAnswer: Can't find the answer you're looking for? We're here to help.
faq.generalA1: Thulo Bazaar is Nepal's leading online classifieds marketplace where you can buy, sell, and rent products and services across the country.
faq.generalQ2: How do I create an account?
faq.generalA2: Click on Sign Up at the top of the page. Register using your email address or phone number. You'll receive a verification code to confirm your account.
faq.generalQ3: Is Thulo Bazaar free to use?
faq.generalA3: Yes! Creating an account, browsing and posting basic ads is completely free. We offer optional premium features for more visibility.
faq.generalA4: Yes. AI helps review new and edited ads, can suggest a title, category, description and price when you post from photos, warns you about likely mistakes before you submit, and answers support chats first. Humans always make the final call — AI never permanently rejects your ad or your account.
faq.generalQ5: Am I chatting with a real person in support?
faq.generalA5: Your first replies may come from our AI assistant, which answers instantly and solves common questions. If it can't help — or if you ask for a human — your ticket is forwarded to the Thulo Bazaar team and a real person takes over.
faq.buyingQ1: How do I contact a seller?
faq.buyingA1: Click on any ad to view details, then use the Message button to contact the seller through our platform, or use the displayed phone number.
faq.buyingQ2: Is it safe to buy on Thulo Bazaar?
faq.buyingA2: We recommend meeting sellers in public places, inspecting items before payment, and using secure payment methods. Look for verified sellers for added trust.
faq.buyingA3: Yes, most sellers are open to negotiation. Use the messaging feature to discuss price and terms.
faq.sellingQ1: How do I post an ad?
faq.sellingA1: Click Post Free Ad, select a category, fill in the details including title, description, price, and photos. Your ad will be reviewed and published.
faq.sellingQ2: How many photos can I upload?
faq.sellingA2: You can upload up to 10 photos per ad. We recommend using high-quality images that clearly show your item from multiple angles.
faq.sellingQ3: How long do ads stay active?
faq.sellingA3: Standard ads remain active for 30 days. You can renew your ad before it expires.
faq.sellingA4: Ads may be rejected for inappropriate content, misleading information, wrong category, or violation of posting guidelines. You can edit and resubmit.
faq.paymentsA1: We accept eSewa, Khalti, bank transfers, and other popular payment methods in Nepal.
faq.paymentsA2: Featured Ads appear at the top of search results and category pages with a special highlight, getting significantly more views.
faq.paymentsA3: Refunds are available within 24 hours if your promoted ad hasn't been published yet. Contact support for special cases.
faq.accountQ1: How do I verify my account?
faq.accountA1: Go to your Profile Settings and look for the Verification section. You can verify your phone number, email, or apply for business verification.
faq.accountQ2: How do I reset my password?
faq.accountA2: Click Sign In, then Forgot Password. Enter your email address, and we'll send you a reset link.
faq.accountQ3: How do I delete my account?
faq.accountA3: Go to Profile Settings > Security > Delete Account. Note that this action is permanent and will remove all your ads and data.
faq.safetyQ1: How can I stay safe when meeting buyers/sellers?
faq.safetyA1: Always meet in public places during daylight hours. Bring a friend if possible. Never share personal financial information.
faq.safetyQ2: How do I report a suspicious user?
faq.safetyA2: Click the Report button on any ad page or user profile. Select the reason and provide details. Our team reviews all reports within 24 hours.
faq.safetyQ3: What should I do if I encounter fraud?
faq.safetyA3: Report the user immediately through our platform. If you've lost money, file a police report and contact our support team with all evidence.

help.title: Help Center
help.subtitle: Find answers to your questions about Thulo Bazaar
help.noResultsFor: We couldn't find any answers matching "{query}"
help.stillNeedHelpDesc: Can't find what you're looking for? Our support team is here to help you.
help.gettingStartedDesc: New to Thulo Bazaar? Start here.
help.gettingStartedA1: Thulo Bazaar is Nepal's leading online classifieds marketplace where you can buy, sell, and rent products and services. We connect buyers and sellers across Nepal for electronics, vehicles, property, jobs, and much more.
help.gettingStartedQ2: How do I create an account?
help.gettingStartedA2: Click on "Sign Up" at the top of the page. You can register using your email address or phone number. You'll receive a verification code to confirm your account. Once verified, you can start posting ads and contacting sellers.
help.gettingStartedQ3: Is it free to use Thulo Bazaar?
help.gettingStartedA3: Yes! Creating an account and browsing ads is completely free. Posting basic ads is also free. We offer optional premium features like Featured Ads, Urgent tags, and Sticky posts to help your ads get more visibility.
help.gettingStartedQ4: What can I sell on Thulo Bazaar?
help.gettingStartedA4: You can sell a wide variety of items including electronics, vehicles, property, fashion, home goods, services, and more. However, illegal items, weapons, drugs, and prohibited content are strictly not allowed.
help.postingAdsDesc: Learn how to create effective ads.
help.postingAdsQ1: How do I post an ad?
help.postingAdsA1: Click "Post Free Ad" button, select a category, fill in the details including title, description, price, and photos. Add your contact information and submit. Your ad will be reviewed and published within 24 hours.
help.postingAdsA2: Ads may be rejected for various reasons: inappropriate content, misleading information, wrong category, poor quality images, or violation of our posting guidelines. You'll receive a notification explaining why and can edit and resubmit your ad.
help.postingAdsQ3: How many photos can I upload?
help.postingAdsA3: You can upload up to 10 photos per ad. We recommend using high-quality images that clearly show your item from multiple angles. The first image will be used as the primary thumbnail.
help.postingAdsQ4: How long will my ad stay active?
help.postingAdsA4: Standard ads remain active for 30 days. You can renew your ad before it expires. Premium and Featured ads may have different durations based on the package you choose.
help.postingAdsQ5: Can I edit my ad after posting?
help.postingAdsA5: Yes, you can edit your ad anytime from your Dashboard. Go to "My Ads", find the ad you want to edit, and click "Edit". Some changes may require re-review by our moderation team.
help.postingAdsQ6: How does AI help when I post an ad?
help.postingAdsA6: Add photos first and the AI can suggest a title, category, description, and an editable price estimate. It also checks your ad before and after you submit: most ads go live within minutes, and some are held briefly so our team can look. If your ad is held, the reason is shown in your dashboard — a human makes the final decision, never the AI.
help.buyingDesc: Tips for safe and smart buying.
help.buyingQ1: How do I contact a seller?
help.buyingA1: Click on any ad to view details, then use the "Message" button to send a message to the seller through our platform, or use the displayed phone number to call/message directly.
help.buyingQ2: Is it safe to buy on Thulo Bazaar?
help.buyingA2: We recommend meeting sellers in public places, inspecting items before payment, and using secure payment methods. Look for verified sellers (blue checkmark) for added trust. Never send money without seeing the item.
help.buyingQ3: How do I report a suspicious ad or seller?
help.buyingA3: Click the "Report" button on any ad page or user profile. Select the reason for reporting and provide details. Our moderation team reviews all reports within 24 hours.
help.buyingA4: Yes, most sellers are open to negotiation. Use the messaging feature to discuss price and terms. If the ad shows "Price Negotiable", the seller has indicated they're open to offers.
help.accountQ1: How do I verify my account?
help.accountA1: Go to your Profile Settings and look for the Verification section. You can verify your phone number, email, or apply for business verification. Verified accounts get a badge and appear more trustworthy to buyers.
help.accountQ2: How do I reset my password?
help.accountA2: Click "Sign In", then "Forgot Password". Enter your email address, and we'll send you a reset link. The link expires in 1 hour for security reasons.
help.accountQ3: How do I delete my account?
help.accountA3: Go to Profile Settings > Security > Delete Account. Note that this action is permanent and will remove all your ads and data. Contact support if you need to recover accidentally deleted accounts.
help.accountA4: Business accounts are for registered businesses and dealers. They get additional features like a shop page, business verification badge, priority support, and bulk posting tools. Apply through your account settings.
help.accountA5: Our AI assistant replies first — instantly, in English or Nepali — and can solve most common questions. Anything it can't solve (payments, refunds, verification decisions, account changes) is forwarded to the Thulo Bazaar team automatically. You can also just ask for a human at any time.
help.paymentsDesc: Understand our payment and promotion options.
help.paymentsQ1: What payment methods do you accept?
help.paymentsA1: We accept eSewa, Khalti, bank transfers, and other popular payment methods in Nepal. All payments are processed securely through our payment partners.
help.paymentsA2: Featured Ads appear at the top of search results and category pages with a special highlight. They get significantly more views and faster responses. Prices vary by category and duration.
help.paymentsQ3: How do Urgent and Sticky tags work?
help.paymentsA3: Urgent tags add a visible badge to your ad indicating time-sensitivity. Sticky posts keep your ad at the top of the category for the duration you choose. Both help your ad stand out from regular listings.
help.paymentsQ4: Can I get a refund for promotions?
help.paymentsA4: Refunds are available within 24 hours if your promoted ad hasn't been published yet. Once published, promotions are non-refundable. Contact support for special cases.
help.safetyDesc: Stay safe while buying and selling.
help.safetyQ1: How can I stay safe when meeting buyers/sellers?
help.safetyA1: Always meet in public places during daylight hours. Bring a friend if possible. Never share personal financial information. For expensive items, consider meeting at a police station or bank.
help.safetyQ2: What should I do if I encounter fraud?
help.safetyA2: Report the user immediately through our platform. If you've lost money, file a police report. Contact our support team with all evidence (messages, transaction records).
help.safetyQ3: How does Thulo Bazaar protect my data?
help.safetyA3: We use industry-standard encryption and security practices. Your password is hashed and never stored in plain text. We don't share your personal information with third parties without consent.
help.safetyQ4: Why do some users have verification badges?
help.safetyA4: Verification badges indicate the user has verified their identity. Blue checkmarks mean phone/email verified. Green badges indicate verified businesses. These help you identify trustworthy users.

privacyPolicy.title: Privacy Policy
privacyPolicy.intro: At Thulo Bazaar, we are committed to protecting your privacy. This Privacy Policy explains how we collect, use, store, and share your personal information when you use our platform.
privacyPolicy.accountInfoDesc: When you register on Thulo Bazaar, we collect your full name, phone number, email address (optional), and password (stored securely using encryption). If you sign up using Google, we receive your name, email, and profile picture from Google.
privacyPolicy.profileInfoDesc: You may choose to provide additional details such as a bio, avatar, cover photo, location, formatted address, and social media links (Facebook, Instagram, TikTok).
privacyPolicy.verificationDocsDesc: If you apply for Individual Verification, we collect your ID document type, document number, front and back photos of your ID, and a selfie with your ID. For Business Verification, we collect your business name, license document, business category, description, and other business details. These documents are used solely for verification purposes.
privacyPolicy.adDataDesc: When you post an ad, we store the ad title, description, price, category, location (including coordinates), images, and contact information you choose to share.
privacyPolicy.messagingDataDesc: Our platform provides a real-time messaging system between buyers and sellers. We store message content, attachments, read receipts, and conversation history to facilitate communication.
privacyPolicy.paymentInfoDesc: When you make payments for ad promotions or verification fees, we record the transaction details including amount, payment method (Khalti or eSewa), transaction ID, and payment status. We do not store your payment credentials — all payment processing is handled securely by our payment partners.
privacyPolicy.locationDataDesc: We collect location information (latitude, longitude, address) when you post ads or set your profile location. This helps buyers find listings near them.
privacyPolicy.usageDataDesc: We automatically collect certain data when you use our platform, including IP address (for ad view tracking and security), browser type and user agent, pages visited and features used, and ad view timestamps.
privacyPolicy.howWeUseInfoDesc: We use your information to provide, maintain, and improve Thulo Bazaar services; verify your identity for trust and safety; process payments for promotions and verification; enable communication between buyers and sellers; send notifications about your account, ads, and messages; detect and prevent fraud, spam, and abuse; enforce our Terms of Service; and comply with legal obligations.
privacyPolicy.cookiesAndTrackingDesc: We use cookies and similar technologies for session management (keeping you logged in via secure session cookies), authentication tokens (JWT tokens for API access), and analytics to understand how our platform is used. You can manage cookie preferences through your browser settings. Disabling cookies may affect certain features like staying logged in.
privacyPolicy.thirdPartyServicesDesc: We work with trusted third-party service providers to operate our platform:
privacyPolicy.thirdPartyKhalti: Khalti — Payment processing for promotions and verification fees
privacyPolicy.thirdPartyFirebase: Firebase — Push notifications to keep you updated
privacyPolicy.thirdPartySMS: AakashSMS — Phone number verification via OTP
privacyPolicy.thirdPartyAdMob: Google AdMob — Advertising SDK (bundled in the mobile app; may collect advertising ID for analytics and future ad delivery)
privacyPolicy.thirdPartyNote: These services have their own privacy policies and we encourage you to review them.
privacyPolicy.aiProcessingDesc: To provide AI-assisted features, some of the content you submit — ad photos, titles, descriptions, prices, and support chat messages — is processed by third-party AI service providers on our behalf. We share only the content needed for the feature, and we never share your password, payment credentials, or verification documents with AI providers. Automated screening may hold an ad for human review, but final negative decisions (such as rejecting an ad) are made by people, not machines. In support chat, an AI assistant may reply first; you can ask for a human at any time.
privacyPolicy.dataRetentionDesc: We retain your data for as long as your account is active or as needed to provide our services.
privacyPolicy.dataDeletionProcessDesc: When you request account deletion, your account enters a 30-day soft deletion period. During this period, your account is deactivated and not visible to other users. If you log in within 30 days, your account is automatically reactivated and the deletion is cancelled. After 30 days, your account and all associated data (ads, images, messages, verification documents, favourites, and payment records) are permanently and irreversibly deleted.
privacyPolicy.mobileAppPermissionsDesc: Our Android and iOS apps request device permissions that are used only for the stated purpose. You can grant or revoke any permission at any time from your device settings.
privacyPolicy.mobilePermCameraDesc: Required when you take a new photo for an ad or profile picture. We never access the camera in the background.
privacyPolicy.mobilePermPhotosDesc: Required when you pick existing photos from your gallery for an ad or profile. Only the photos you select are uploaded.
privacyPolicy.mobilePermLocationDesc: Optional. If you grant it, we use your location to auto-fill your ad location and show nearby ads. Location access only happens while the app is in use — never in the background.
privacyPolicy.mobilePermNotificationsDesc: Optional. If you grant it, we send push notifications for new messages, offers on your ads, and order updates. Delivered via Firebase Cloud Messaging (FCM).
privacyPolicy.mobilePermStorageDesc: Used to communicate with our servers and cache images locally for faster loading.
privacyPolicy.mobileDeviceIdentifiersDesc: The app may collect your Firebase Installation ID (used for push notification delivery) and Android Advertising ID / iOS IDFA (used by Google AdMob SDK for analytics and ad delivery). You can reset the advertising ID at any time from your device settings.
privacyPolicy.dataSecurityDesc: We implement industry-standard security measures to protect your information, including encrypted password storage (bcrypt hashing), JWT-based authentication with token rotation, two-factor authentication (TOTP) support, rate limiting to prevent brute-force attacks, HTTPS encryption for all data transmission, and HTTP security headers.
privacyPolicy.yourRightsDesc: You have the right to access and view your personal information through your profile settings; update or correct your information at any time; request deletion of your account and data; opt out of promotional notifications; and contact us with any privacy concerns.
privacyPolicy.childrensPrivacyDesc: Thulo Bazaar is not intended for users under 16 years of age. We do not knowingly collect personal information from children. If you believe a minor has provided us with personal data, please contact us and we will take steps to remove that information.
privacyPolicy.changesToPolicyDesc: We may update this Privacy Policy from time to time. We will notify you of significant changes through our platform or via email. Your continued use of Thulo Bazaar after changes are posted constitutes acceptance of the updated policy.
privacyPolicy.contactUsDesc: If you have any questions or concerns about this Privacy Policy or how we handle your data, please contact us through our Contact page or Support Ticket system.

termsOfService.title: Terms of Service
termsOfService.intro: Welcome to Thulo Bazaar. By accessing or using our platform, you agree to be bound by these Terms of Service. Please read them carefully before using our services.
termsOfService.acceptanceOfTermsDesc: By creating an account, posting ads, or using any part of Thulo Bazaar, you acknowledge that you have read, understood, and agree to be bound by these Terms. If you do not agree, please do not use our platform.
termsOfService.accountRegistrationDesc: You must be at least 16 years old to create an account. You are responsible for maintaining the security of your account credentials. You must provide accurate and truthful information during registration. Each person may only maintain one account. You are responsible for all activities that occur under your account.
termsOfService.postingAdsDesc: When posting ads on Thulo Bazaar, you must provide accurate descriptions, images, and pricing. You must not post illegal, fraudulent, or misleading content. Ads must comply with our content guidelines and community standards. Thulo Bazaar reserves the right to review, reject, suspend, or remove any ad that violates our policies. Ads may be subject to our profanity filter and content moderation systems.
termsOfService.prohibitedContentDesc: The following are strictly prohibited: illegal goods or services, counterfeit or stolen items, weapons and explosives, drugs and controlled substances, adult content, discriminatory or hateful content, and any content that violates Nepal's laws.
termsOfService.paymentsDesc: Thulo Bazaar uses Khalti and eSewa as payment gateways for paid services. All payments are processed securely through these third-party providers. Prices are displayed in Nepalese Rupees (NPR).
termsOfService.promotionsDesc: We offer paid promotion services (Featured, Urgent, and Sticky) to increase your ad's visibility. After successful payment, promotions are activated immediately for the selected duration.
termsOfService.promotionsIssue: If your promotion is not showing or there is a technical issue with your paid promotion, Thulo Bazaar will reapply the promotion for the correct duration at no extra cost. We do not offer cash refunds for promotions — the remedy is providing the promotion service you paid for.
termsOfService.verificationDesc: We offer Individual Verification (ID-based) and Business Verification (license-based) to help build trust on the platform. Verification involves document review by our team.
termsOfService.verificationRefund: Verification fees are non-refundable. If your verification application is rejected, you will not receive a refund. However, you may resubmit your application with corrected documents at no additional charge. Please ensure all documents are accurate and valid before submitting.
termsOfService.verificationExpiry: Verification is valid for the selected duration (e.g., 30 days, 90 days, 180 days, or 365 days). After expiration, you will need to re-verify and pay the applicable fee.
termsOfService.refundPromotion: Ad Promotions — No cash refunds. If there is a payment or display issue, we will reapply the promotion.
termsOfService.refundVerification: Verification Fees — Non-refundable, even if the application is rejected. Free resubmission is allowed.
termsOfService.refundGeneral: All sales are final unless there is a proven technical error on our part, in which case the service will be re-provided.
termsOfService.accountDeletionDesc: You may request to delete your account at any time from your profile settings. Deletion requires verification via OTP sent to your registered phone number.
termsOfService.accountDeletionProcess: Upon confirmation, your account enters a 30-day soft deletion period. During this period your account is deactivated but your data is preserved. If you change your mind, simply log in within 30 days — your account will be automatically reactivated and the deletion request cancelled.
termsOfService.accountDeletionFinal: After 30 days, your account and all associated data are permanently deleted. This action is irreversible. Permanent deletion includes all your ads and images, messages and conversations, verification documents and records, payment history, favourites, and profile information.
termsOfService.messagingDesc: Our messaging system is provided for communication between buyers and sellers regarding listed items. You must not use messaging for spam, harassment, fraud, or any illegal purpose. Thulo Bazaar may moderate messages to enforce our community guidelines and profanity filter.
termsOfService.contentModerationDesc: Thulo Bazaar uses automated systems — including artificial intelligence (AI) — together with human moderators to keep the marketplace safe: new and edited ads are screened by AI and may be published automatically or held for review by our team, profanity is filtered in multiple languages, and users can report ads and shops. AI screening never permanently rejects your content on its own — removal and rejection decisions are made by our human team. Repeated violations may result in temporary or permanent account suspension.
termsOfService.aiFeaturesDesc: Some Thulo Bazaar features are powered by artificial intelligence: ad screening and review, optional suggestions when you create an ad (title, category, description, and an editable price estimate from your photos), pre-submission warnings, and an AI support assistant that may answer your support messages first. AI suggestions are always editable, and you can request a human at any time in support chat — your ticket will be forwarded to our team. AI features may be changed or withdrawn at any time.
termsOfService.intellectualPropertyDesc: All content, design, and branding on Thulo Bazaar are the intellectual property of Thulo Bazaar. Users retain ownership of the content they post but grant Thulo Bazaar a non-exclusive license to display, distribute, and promote that content on the platform.
termsOfService.limitationOfLiabilityDesc: Thulo Bazaar is a classifieds marketplace that connects buyers and sellers. We do not guarantee the quality, safety, or legality of items listed. We are not a party to transactions between users. We do not verify the accuracy of all ad listings. Users transact at their own risk. Thulo Bazaar shall not be liable for any direct, indirect, incidental, or consequential damages arising from use of the platform.
termsOfService.governingLawDesc: These Terms are governed by and construed in accordance with the laws of Nepal, including the Electronic Transactions Act 2063 (2008) and the Privacy Act 2075 (2018). Any disputes shall be subject to the exclusive jurisdiction of the courts of Nepal.
termsOfService.changesToTermsDesc: We reserve the right to update these Terms at any time. Significant changes will be communicated through the platform. Your continued use after changes are posted constitutes acceptance of the updated Terms.
termsOfService.contactUsDesc: If you have any questions about these Terms of Service, please contact us through our Contact page or Support Ticket system.

liveChat.title: Live Chat
liveChat.subtitle: Instant answers — a real person joins when needed
liveChat.emptyBody: Ask anything about buying, selling, ads, verification or payments.
liveChat.aiNotice: Answered by our AI assistant first. It passes you to the Thulo Bazaar team whenever it cannot help.
liveChat.profanityWarning: Please use respectful language. Offensive words are not allowed on Thulo Bazaar.
liveChat.signInMessage: Sign in to start chatting with us.
